title: NEW Southern US Destination! Lafayette Regional Airport (KLFT) in MSFS 2020
description:
If you're looking to expand your regional US route network or shoot low-altitude scenic approaches across the southern bayous, the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 Marketplace just updated with a brand-new Gulf Coast arrival. Whether you're flying regional hops out of major hubs like Atlanta, Dallas, or Houston, or cruising low over Louisiana in general aviation aircraft, this latest release adds a dedicated destination to your simulator map!

In this marketplace breakdown, we inspect all the airfield modeling upgrades, custom taxiway work, and terminal exterior details to help you decide what's claiming top priority on your virtual SSD:

⚜️ CAJUN COUNTRY HUB: LAFAYETTE REGIONAL AIRPORT (KLFT)
We travel down to southern Louisiana in Lafayette Parish to explore the newly released Lafayette Regional Airport (KLFT), developed by MSFSceneryBuilders. Located four kilometers southeast of Lafayette and operated by the City-Parish of Lafayette, this airfield receives a solid visual overhaul compared to default procedural scenery. We inspect the revamped aprons, updated taxiway markings, the custom terminal building exterior, and the signature ground buses and apron equipment provided by the developer.

Are you adding Lafayette Regional to your flight schedule for authentic southern feeder runs, or do you prefer sticking with larger international hubs? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2020 additions, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
